data.body: Residual-risk disposition from the final current-material plan review: accepted — pytest_sessionstart is a second caller of the same `porcelain()` helper exercised through pytest_sessionfinish and direct blocked-probe tests. The timeout, stable subprocess runner, and stable sleep boundary are implemented inside that shared helper; exact-defect mutations returned the helper-level and real-hook oracles to RED, and Gerrit CI passed the complete cross-platform suite. No separate session-start mechanism or divergent behavior was observed, so an additional duplicate hook wrapper test would add maintenance without materially stronger fault coverage.
